plan.english: Father Sky, hear our words. Giver of good things, we sing of you. You hold up the broad space of light. You are great among the gods. With heavy thunder you split the vault. Then the waters came forth from it. The broad earth drank the water. You look upon us from above. You know the long paths of the stars. Our hearts and minds are turned towards you. The dogs are afraid of your thunder. Give us swift horses. Guard our sheep from the wolf. May our fame be imperishable. Shining one, listen to our song.

Sky, father of the gods, we praise you. We sing your famous name. You set the seven stars on the vault. You set the sun on its course. You gave light to the sun. Now the night is gone; Dawn, your daughter, has arrived. She brings us bright radiance. The stars vanish, and the warriors wake up. Guard our horses and sheep. May the wolf not seize them from the fields. Give us good fame. May we see the sun; may our offspring live.

Father Sky, you thunder from above. Your thunder is great and heavy. The earth trembles, and the sea trembles. The cattle are afraid in the fields. Your wind stirs up the sea. The crawling serpent was hiding the waters. You slew the serpent with thunder and freed the waters for us. Now the waters go down to the earth. Slayer, we sing of you and praise you. Do not strike down our warriors in the war. Protect our fields and fences. May your fame be imperishable.

Bright Sky, you are the giver of good things. Your radiance fills the broad paths. Your stars shine above. Your sun walks on a long course. Who knows your great mind? The gods do not know your mind. The gods were astonished at your works. You alone know it, allotter. You set famous names for the gods. You placed seed in Mother Earth. From her grew ears of grain and roots. Now we give you butter. Receive it, and become joyful in your heart. Give us wealth and might.

Sky, great shining father, listen! You who split the vault, you we praise. You who set the stars, you we sing. You who freed the waters, to you we pray. Your great fame has reached the gods. We trust you, and we do not fear death. Look upon our works from above. May our bulls and sheep become strong. May our warriors be swift. May the wolf not come to our fences. Allotter, we give you this song. Hear it and receive it.

Dawn, shining daughter of Sky, grow bright! You who drove away the darkness, you we sing. Night, your sister, went away with the stars. You came to us on a swift chariot. You wear radiance and splendor. You walk through the middle of the space of light. You clothe the branches in brightness. The east and the sea are red. The bulls wake up and look at you. Dawn, bring us wealth. Do not hide your brightness from us. May you shine for us and our brothers. Dawn, we sing of you in our hearts.

title: Dawn Who Lights Up the World

plan.english: Dawn, come to us with radiance. You light up the long paths. You light up the broad earth. You light up the sea. Night gives up the vault to you. Sky gave you a famous name. He set you on your course, Dawn. You come again, and the dogs wake up. The warriors yoke their chariots. Dawn, give us wealth and wool. May we catch sight of your light and splendor again. Do not leave us in the darkness, Dawn.

Dawn, daughter of Sky, we sing of you. Night is your sister; she clothes the earth. When you come with radiance, she leaves. You light the earth up with splendor. She follows you, and you follow her. You found the hidden cattle in the darkness. You drove them out and led them to the fields. Then the gods were astonished, and they became joyful. Dawn, now we pray to you. Lead us and our brothers to the light. Guard our fences from the wolf. May your brightness not go away from us.

Dawn, you have come; the darkness is gone. Dawn, you are our light. You shine on the sea and the waters. You shine on the roots and the branches. You shine on the gods and on the dead. Shine for us, Dawn; shine for our brothers. When you flashed up, the gods became joyful; they sang a song to you. Now we sing that song to you again. Daughter of Sky, receive our words. Give us victory and fame. May we be free from fear. Shining one, we praise you in our hearts.

Where are you, Dawn, daughter of Sky? The night is long and heavy for us. The widows are afraid; the dogs are afraid. We want to see your light and brightness. The darkness swallowed the sun and the stars. You split it with your splendor and light. Then the sun came forth from it. Now you have come forth in the east, Dawn. You stretch your radiance over the fields. Come to us again, Dawn; do not go away from us. We praisers sing you a song. Your fame, Dawn, is imperishable.

Sun, listen to our words. Two swift horses draw your wheel. You climb to the middle of the vault. You see the fields and the waters. Who hides himself from your light? Night and the stars hide from your light. The gods built your wheel. They joined two horses to it. The two do not become tired; the two do not lie down. Sun, heat the seeds for us. Ripen our ears of grain; may they become tasty. May we catch sight of you, and may our hearts become joyful.

Sun, you go up in the east. From above you look at our works. You know our oaths and our words. Whoever breaks an oath, you see him. Whoever guards an oath, him you guard. Then you go down to the salty sea. Then the stars shine in the sky. The serpent seized you; Dawn split it. She freed you from it, and you came forth again. Now your wheel shines for us with splendor. Sun, give us light and wealth. May we and our brothers stand in your light.

title: The Seven Horses of the Sun

plan.english: Sun, bright wheel, come forth! Your seven swift horses carry you. You walk along your long course. Dawn made your path straight. Your fire burns the darkness. The waters become warm, and the ears of grain ripen. The eastern waters were hiding you. Dawn caught sight of you and led you out. Then you went up to the middle of the vault. Sun, we sing your famous name. Look upon us and our brothers. Sun, do not hide yourself from us.

Sun, you go under the earth to the dead. There the dead are lying in sleep. You alone of the gods see them. You light up their long sleep. Then you come forth from the eastern waters. You follow Dawn on her course. Your light has reached the fields. The beavers swim in the waters. Your wheel turns, and it does not break. Sun, do not burn our seed. May our ears of grain be heavy and good. Give light to the dead.

Fire, giver of good things, we sing of you. You are born from the waters. You carry our gifts to the gods. Fire, you speak to the gods for us. You lick the butter, and your fire burns. You hid yourself in the branches. The gods sought you and caught sight of you. They led you out, and they seated you in the middle. Bring them to us, Fire. May they sit down and drink the wine. Fire, guard our sleep and our fences. Do not burn us, swift Fire.

Bright Fire, wake up with the dawn. We give you grain and wine. You eat them, and your fire becomes big. You heat the waters, and they boil. You melt the butter for us. You light up the night. The wolf and the serpent are afraid of you. They do not come near our fences and our sheep. The gods gave you to us and to our offspring. We seat you in the middle, and we sing to you. Fire, do not vanish from our fences. May your fire be unfailing. Giver of good things, give us might.

Fire, your might is great. You who split the darkness, you we sing. You protect the bulls in the fences. You guard the warriors and the widows. You guard us in the long night. The wolf is afraid and goes away. The darkness seized the sun and the stars. You came forth with radiance and drove it away. Now you dwell inside our fences. Fire, safeguard us with your fire. May the serpent not creep to us. Giver of good things, we bring you our words.

Fire, carrier of songs, listen to us. The praisers sing of you. Fire, you know the long ways. Carry our song to Sky, the allotter. Carry our butter to Dawn. Carry our grain to the Sun. May the gods be sated with our gifts. You went to the gods and brought their word to us. Your fire shines for the gods. Give us imperishable fame. May we live in your radiance. Fire, we sing your famous name.

Fire, the long night has come; the waters have become cold. We place your fire on the earth. We give it fat. The wind blows on it. Then the fire grew large, and it lit up the waters. It heats us; it cooks our grain. We sit around it and speak words. Fire, you live in it; you are the god of the fire. The gods hid the fire in the stone. You split the stone, and the fire came forth from it. Fire, do not burn our fences. May your fire not die; may it not vanish.

Waters, mothers, hear our words. You go down to the salty sea. You nourish the fields and the cattle. You nourish the seed and the ears of grain. You nourish the roots and the branches. Whoever drinks you, he lives. The thirsty roots drink you. The serpent was hiding you in the darkness. A great god slew the serpent. He freed you from it, and you came forth into the radiance. Waters, carry the stain away from us. Give us power and wealth. May your water become tasty for us and for our bulls.

Waters of Sky, come to us. You fall down from the vault to the broad fields. You fill the sea with water. You go into the earth; the roots drink you. The seed grows from them. You are free and swift. You and Dawn are the daughters of Sky. The Slayer split the vault with thunder. You came forth from it and went down. Fish swim in your waters. Waters, nourish our bulls. Do not dry up for us; may our offspring drink you.

Seven Waters, sisters, listen to us. You go along seven paths to the sea. The salty sea receives you. Cattle and dogs drink you. Fire is born from you. Fire dwells in your waters. You are the mothers of famous Fire. The serpent swallowed you, and the earth became thirsty. The Slayer split the serpent; you came forth again into the radiance. Sisters, go to our fields. Nourish the seed and the roots. May this year's grain become full.

Who are you, bright and swift ones? We are the Waters, the daughters of Sky. Where do you go on your courses? We go down to the salty sea. What do you carry in your waters? We carry the stains away. What do you give to the roots, sisters? We give water to the roots. Daughters of Sky, we pray to you. Carry our stains away. Nourish our offspring and our swift horses. May you not dry up for us, sisters.

Broad Mother Earth, we sing of you. You carry the cattle and the horses. You carry the waters and the sea. You carry the roots and the seeds. Your navel lies in the middle. There the dead lie side by side. Who created you and your fields, broad one? The gods created you with their hands. Earth, you are productive, and you nourish us. Sky gave you seed, and grain grew from you. Nourish our bulls, and may our ears of grain grow. When our spirit goes away, receive us.

title: Earth Who Stands Beneath the Sky

plan.english: Mother Earth, you stand beneath the sky. You do not tremble at the heavy thunder. Beavers live in your waters. Your grain nourishes us. We stand on your navel. There we light the fire. There we speak good words. The waters clothed you; the gods lifted you up. They set a famous name on you, and you rejoiced. You became broad and great. May you stand for us and our offspring. Give us wealth and imperishable fame.

Earth, mother of the gods, we praise you. Sky is above, and you are below. He gives radiance; you give seed. Our fathers died, and you received them. Now they lie inside, in sleep. You hide them from the sun and the wind. You guard their long sleep of death. Remember them, Earth, and remember us. Give us offspring and wool. May our wealth and our offspring increase. May our name be famous among the warriors. Broad one, we give you gifts.

Mother Earth, your fields are broad. Your sheep give wool. Your bulls are swift and heavy. We milk your cattle; we eat your grain. We drink your water, and our hearts become joyful. What do we give you in exchange? In exchange we give you songs and butter. Sky saw you, and he came to love you. The gods are born from you and from Sky. The gods stand on your navel. Protect our offspring and our sheep. Earth, hear our words.

Gods, givers of good things, come to us! Sit down in the middle and drink the wine. Become joyful, gods, in your hearts. Father Sky, come with your daughter Dawn. Fire, bring the Sun and the Waters. Mother Earth, listen to us. Gods, you slew the serpent with thunder. You freed the waters and the cattle from the stone. You set the sun and the stars above. Now we sing your great fame. Give us victory and might. Protect us from the wolf and from sores. Your might is imperishable.

Gods of Sky, we praise you. Great Sky is your father. Earth is your mother. Dawn is your sister. Fire carries our gifts to you. The Sun sees our works. Darkness lay on the waters. You split it with light and radiance. Dawn came forth, and the Sun became bright. Now the cattle live, and the waters live. Gods, do not give us up. Give us splendor and wealth.

Which god shall we praise with our words? Shall we praise Father Sky? Shall we praise Dawn, the daughter of Sky? Shall we praise the Sun and Fire? Let us praise the gods of Sky and of Earth. They are the givers of good things. They gave us fire, water, and seed. They split the vault and freed the waters. They set famous names on the stars. Let us give them butter. May they drink it, and may they become joyful. May they guard us and our brothers. May they hear our songs and come to us.

Fire, I bring you butter. I prepared it for you with my hands. I give you grain; I sing you a song. Receive them, Fire, and carry them to the gods. You are the carrier of our gifts. I ask you for cattle and wealth. I ask for offspring and fame. Give them to me, Fire, in exchange. Guard me from the wolf and from fear. Fire, do not burn me and my brother. I am your praiser, and you are my god. May I catch sight of the dawn and the sun again.

title: A Herdsman's Prayer to Father Sky

plan.english: Father Sky, I pray to you. My cattle are missing; the wolf seized them. My heart trembles in fear, and my mind is upset. I seek them, and my dog is tracking them. I did not catch sight of them; you see them from above. Show them to me, great allotter. Lead them again to my fences. Strike him down with your heavy thunder. May they not die, and may they not be lost. I shall give you a bull and wine. I shall sing your famous name. Hear me, allotter; do not leave me.

title: A Sacrificer's Morning Prayer to Dawn

plan.english: Dawn, I woke up in the darkness. I lit the fire for the gods. I prepared the butter and the wine. Now I sing of you, and I pray to you. Come forth, shining daughter of Sky. Light up my paths and my fences. Bring brightness to my heart. Drive the wolf away from my sheep. Give me wealth and might. I give you this song. May I and my brother catch sight of you. Do not leave me, Dawn; come again.

title: A Prayer to the Waters for Cleansing

plan.english: Swift Waters, I have come to you. There is a stain on my heart. I broke an oath; the gods caught sight of it. Now I am afraid of them. Waters, carry the stain away from me. Clothe me with your water. I stand bare in your waters. I give you butter and wine. Receive them, daughters of Sky. May the gods not see my stain. May my mind be free from the stain. I shall praise you, and I shall sing of your works.

title: A Ploughman's Prayer to Mother Earth

plan.english: Mother Earth, I plough you. My two bulls are working. I give you seed; I give you butter. I give you a song and my words. Receive them, broad Earth. Sky, the allotter, gives you water. May the grain come forth; may the ears become full. May the sun not dry them up. In exchange, give me wealth. Nourish my cattle and my horses. May my offspring live, and may he become rich. I shall bring you the leftover grain.

title: A Prayer to the Sun Against a Sore

plan.english: Sun, there is a sore on my arm. It is red, and it grows. It burns me at night; at night I am awake. You see my sore from above. Dry it with your light. May the sore vanish from my arm. The darkness seized you; Dawn freed you. Free my arm from the sore. May it go away into the earth. I shall give you a white bull. I shall sing your famous name. Sun, listen to me and hear me.

title: A Warrior's Prayer to the Gods

plan.english: Gods, I am your warrior. I go to war with my brothers. Two horses carry my chariot. My heart and my mind do not tremble in fear. Protect me in the war, gods. May I not die there; may I not fall there. May I overcome the warriors with my might. May the wolves and the dogs eat the dead. You overcame the serpent; Father Sky struck it down with thunder. Give me victory in the war. If I come back, I shall give you seven cattle. May my fame be imperishable.

title: A Traveller's Prayer to the Sun

plan.english: Sun, you know the ways; you do not go astray. I go on a long path to my brother. On it there are serpents and thorns. Go on ahead; light it up for me. Guard my steps with your brightness. May I not go astray from it, Sun. May the wolves and the dogs not catch sight of me. May I arrive there, and may he see me. My mother is praying to you. My sister is sitting by the fire. May I come back to them again with wealth. Sun, I shall give you wine.

title: A Father's Prayer for His Newborn

plan.english: Gods, my offspring is born. His mother has become tired, and her heart has become joyful. I set a famous name on him. Hear it, gods, and remember it. Guard him from sores and from fear. May he grow and see the sun. May he drive swift horses. May his fame be great among the warriors. Sky, protect him from above with your thunder. Broad Earth, nourish him. Dawn, shine for him with your splendor. Gods, I shall give you a sheep and wine.

title: A Son's Prayer to Fire for His Dead Father

plan.english: Fire, my father has died; he is gone. He lies on the earth; his two hands have become cold. His widow is sitting near. Fire, do not burn him; carry him to the gods. Lead him on the long path. You carried our fathers yonder. You led them up to the sky of the gods. Now they live there with the gods. May he sit with them and drink the wine. May he see the sun and the dawn again. May his name be good. I give you butter, Fire.
